captureNote: The .txt holds the original terminal capture bytes, including the leading `connected` line, which is not JSON. This file is the parseable restatement of the same response; no field was added or changed.
method: Read-only client on the named pipe \\.\pipe\codex-ipc: read frames, send one initialize request, read the response. No other method was called and no state was written.
framing: 4-byte little-endian length prefix followed by a JSON body
limits: One initialize response from one Desktop session at one moment. It shows this response carries no pid, version or instance field; it does not enumerate other IPC methods, other connections, or OS-level handle metadata.
